name: snagboat
description: Watches AI coding agent activity and shows token/event counts locally.

snagboat.copilot.otlpPort.description: Local port Snagboat listens on for Copilot Chat's OpenTelemetry export. Point github.copilot.chat.otel.otlpEndpoint at http://127.0.0.1:<this port>.

scripts.pretest: npm run compile-tests && npm run build
scripts.test:unit: npm run compile-tests && node ./out/test/unit/core.unit.test.js && node ./out/test/unit/claudeCode.unit.test.js && node ./out/test/unit/copilot.unit.test.js && node ./out/test/unit/format.unit.test.js && node ./out/test/unit/eventStore.unit.test.js && node ./out/test/unit/heuristics.unit.test.js
